9894513239

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY:

Subject Matter expert and Emerging Lead with 8+ years of experience in end to end reconciliation in Capital Market Operations and Asset servicing with willingness to extend my career in the new challenging role where I can use my skills & knowledge in the best possible way for achieving the company’s goal and learn from my experience for the betterment of my services which contributes to the success of the organization.

WORK EXPERIENCE:

SUBJECT MATTER EXPERT/EMERGING LEAD- STATE STREET HCL SERVICES

AUGUST 2022- JUNE 2026



•

Reconciliation of daily cash and Position between Client vs multiple Brokers for multiple currencies and ensuring that the deliverable is met consistently with highest quality. Part of the Migration and helping the team to set up the process for smooth flow and resolving the issue in setting up for the Fund. Posting of Dividend using Proper backup, Accruals, Daily Postings and Transfer. Closely in touch with RXP team, Onboarding team, State Street over site Team, OPS Team and NAV team to solve the flow of the transaction and balance in Mosiki application.

Good exposure in dealing with various asset classes like Equities, Fixed Income, Collaterals, FX and Derivative products and Corporate Actions.

Have good understanding of Hedge fund accounting and administration. Booking all Capital activities such as Subscription, Redemption, Cash transfers and Accrual Interests.

Working on the complex accounts, Provides Guidance to Junior team members and reviewing. • Organizing and handling daily call with internal teams, Prime Brokers, RXP team and • Onboarding team to resolve the aged Issue. Experience in using Bloomberg Terminal for searching information on Corporate Actions, verifying coupon accruals for bonds and Price for securities. And Giving on the job training for new associates & cross training to the team. Performing pricing and Resets for CFDs Brokers (MS, CITI, UBS, BAML, JPY, GS and STST) according to their market price.



Working on the resolution of clearing aged breaks. •

Collaborated cross-functionally with the Net Asset Value (NAV) and Auditing teams to resolve reconciliation breaks, ensuring seamless data backups and compliance during critical audit periods. Create templates for Position Reconciliation and consolidation for aged breaks.



CLIENT PROCESSING REPRESENTATIVE – BANK OF NEW YORK MELLON

JULY 2020- AUGUST 2022

Maintenance of all bank loan activity (Interest rate reset, Principal repayments, principal draw down, facility increase, borrow, pay down and margin changes).

Daily processing of bank loan notices as receive from agent bank in the bank loan systems. • Coordinate with reconciliation (Offshore/Onshore) team for the daily reconciliation of cash balances and CSM’s (Client service managers) in relation to issues and resolve problematic cash discrepancies with agent bank, seller bank through research case. Facility restructuring (Corporate action) due to the technical and non-technical changes.

•

Apply expertise and judgments in providing quality and occasionally complex client service. • Serves as primary point of contact for clients, reconciliation teams, CSM's and supervisors. • Responsible for providing Process Training for New Joiners Ensuring that the trainee hits the production floor once he/she is competent enough to handle the process specific queries with ease Allocating funds to the team and providing status to offshore and onshore management on daily basis. JULY 2017- FEBUARY 2020

Apply expertise and judgments in providing quality and occasionally complex client service. • Serves as primary point of contact for clients, reconciliation teams, CSM's and supervisors. • Responsible for providing Process Training for New Joiners Ensuring that the trainee hits the production floor once he/she is competent enough to handle the process specific queries with ease Allocating funds to the team and providing status to offshore and onshore management on daily basis. JULY 2017- FEBUARY 2020

Downloading reports and loading SWIFT messages into TLM. •

Loading the transaction, clearing OI and correcting the invalid message Feeds by cross verifying with Bank Statements.

Strong knowledge in Cash and Position Reconciliation. • Performed with different funds containing Fixed Income Security, Mutual Fund, Bank Loan and Derivative products.

Performed three-way reconciliation for Custody and Broker statements. • Sending billing sheets to clients on Monthly basis and worked on Client specific templates. • Resolving breaks related to IP, PD, MBS, Bonds, Derivatives etc., • Special reconciliations were done on client specific templates at regular intervals. Prepared SOPs for different activities and processes.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor of Commerce - Professional Accounting

2014-2017

Sri Krishna College of Arts and Science

Higher Secondary – Accounting and Commerce Pandit Nehru Matric Higher Secondary School

2012-2014

TECHNICAL SKILLS:

Applications: TLM, PLM, Geneva, ARO, Bloomberg, Mosiki, Mercer, Solvas and SMARTS Custodian websites used: BNY, SSB, NT, JPM and BOFA. Software used: M S office, Tally

PERSONAL SKILLS:

Adaptive Leadership and Mentoring. • • Critical thinking. • • Synergistic Collaboration. Strong work ethic.

Strategic Problem-Solving

CERTIFICATION AND APPRECIATION:

Completed NISM (National Institute of Securities Markets) Series – VII Securities Operation and risk management – 2018.

Got appreciation for performing proactively in a timely manner.
